_what: What a BattleGrid strategy actually carries, versus what omega.generate emits. Measured 2026-08-26 by diffing StrategyPlan.wire() against the live compile_strategy_plan request schema.
_why: Every verification in this repo compares omega against the READ surface - preview_strategy_report. The WRITE surface is a different schema with different field names and a much larger parameter set. 100% column coverage says nothing about whether the thing you built can be saved.
status: NOT A DEFECT. omega.generate.emit_plan stamps every plan '_generatedBy: omega.generate - LOCAL ONLY, not submitted'. The last mile was deliberately not built. This records the size of it.

keyMismatch._note: signalRules is simply the wrong name - the API calls it `rules`. cadence and regimeTimeframe have no equivalent in the CREATE/UPDATE/RESTORE schemas at all.
keyMismatch._confidence: SCHEMA-DERIVED, NOT MEASURED. The request objects declare additionalProperties: false, so unknown keys should be refused. No compile call has been made to confirm it. One compile would settle it - compile performs no write.
keyMismatch._substantive: coinSelection is the one that matters. A generated strategy currently does not say which coins it trades. The other three are metadata the caller supplies.

_resolved.how: wire() reshaped to the CREATE request; signalRules renamed to rules; cadence/regimeTimeframe moved to emit_plan metadata (_-prefixed, never submitted); operation/intentSummary/assumptions/coinSelection now emitted. coinSelection defaults class-aware: CRYPTO when the thesis weights a crypto-only module (CVD, FLOW_DIVERGENCE), else ALL. Schema re-verified live the same day; the lists above are kept as history.

executionSurfaceNotModelled.grepResult: 5 of the 6 probed - trailingEnabled, breakEvenTriggerR, minStopLossAtrMultiple, timeDecayEnabled, minRiskRewardRatio - appear NOWHERE in omega/ or docs/. Only minAtrPct is mentioned anywhere.
executionSurfaceNotModelled.consequence: omega can author WHAT TO LOOK AT and not HOW TO TRADE IT. A strategy with sound entries and a bad stop loses money, and the toolkit currently has nothing to say about the stop.

whatIsAlreadyProven.writeAxes: REPORT, MARKET_READ and CONDITIONS have all been written and read back - see data/audit/write_path_2026-08-24.json and sweep_2026-08-24.json['conditionsWrite'].
whatIsAlreadyProven.butHandBuilt: All three were written from hand-built payloads. No omega-GENERATED plan has ever been compiled or applied.
whatIsAlreadyProven.rulesAxis: The `rules` array - 84 signalIds with allocation 0-3 and a required flag - has never been written at all. A generated plan carries 84 of them.

nextStep: Rename signalRules -> rules, drop or map cadence/regimeTimeframe, add the four required fields, then run compile_strategy_plan on a generated plan for a real verdict. compile performs NO WRITE, so this is safe and does not touch the agent-binding constraint.
